excerpts: At ActiveFence, we enable automated content moderation at scale. In this post, I described the journey we took, from a small startup with small data, needs to a company with a clear business direction and real-time machine learning on big data at scale. In the end, we realized that to support machine learning at scale, we needed to ensure our data lake was the single source of truth and have a system architecture that supports using and maintaining all this data. Although we constantly rethink and improve our processes, the architecture we have outlined here is flexible and scalable enough to support our needs, while allowing impactful analysis when our clients need it.
**Jonathan Lavon,** Principal Engineer @ ActiveFence.
